description: Source code implementing a modem multiplexing (cmux) protocol for Zephyr OS, including frame handling, command processing, and DLCI (Data Link Connection Identifier) management.

methods.name: modem_cmux_wrap_command
methods.description: Wraps raw data into a modem_cmux_command structure, validating length and header fields.

methods.name: modem_cmux_command_wrap
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a modem_cmux_command structure from raw data.

methods.name: modem_cmux_frame_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts a frame type enum to its string representation.

methods.name: modem_cmux_log_transmit_frame
methods.description: Logs details of a transmitted frame.

methods.name: modem_cmux_log_received_frame
methods.description: Logs details of a received frame.

methods.name: modem_cmux_command_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts a command type enum to its string representation.

methods.name: modem_cmux_log_transmit_command
methods.description: Logs details of a transmitted command.

methods.name: modem_cmux_log_received_command
methods.description: Logs details of a received command.

methods.name: modem_cmux_raise_event
methods.description: Invokes the callback with a specific event.

methods.name: modem_cmux_bus_callback
methods.description: Callback for modem pipe events, schedules receive or transmit work.

methods.name: modem_cmux_transmit_frame
methods.description: Prepares and queues a frame for transmission, including FCS calculation.

methods.name: modem_cmux_transmit_cmd_frame
methods.description: Transmits a command frame if buffer space allows.

methods.name: modem_cmux_transmit_data_frame
methods.description: Transmits a data frame if flow control is enabled and buffer space allows.

methods.name: modem_cmux_acknowledge_received_frame
methods.description: Acknowledges a received frame, potentially retransmitting.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_msc_command
methods.description: Handles MSC command, acknowledges if cr bit is set.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_fcon_command
methods.description: Handles FCON command, enables flow control.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_fcoff_command
methods.description: Handles FCOFF command, disables flow control.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_cld_command
methods.description: Handles CLD command, manages connection state and raises disconnect event.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_control_frame_ua
methods.description: Handles UA control frame, transitions to connected state.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_control_frame_uih
methods.description: Handles UIH control frame, processes embedded command.

methods.name: modem_cmux_connect_response_transmit
methods.description: Sends a UA frame in response to connect request.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_control_frame_sabm
methods.description: Handles SABM frame, establishes connection.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_control_frame
methods.description: Dispatches received control frames based on type.

methods.name: modem_cmux_find_dlci
methods.description: Finds a DLCI by address within the cmux.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_dlci_frame_ua
methods.description: Handles UA frame for a DLCI, updates state.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_dlci_frame_uih
methods.description: Handles UIH frame for a DLCI, writes data to buffer.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_dlci_frame_sabm
methods.description: Handles SABM frame for a DLCI, opens connection.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_dlci_frame_disc
methods.description: Handles DISC frame for a DLCI, closes connection.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_dlci_frame
methods.description: Dispatches DLCI frames based on type.

methods.name: modem_cmux_on_frame
methods.description: Dispatches frames based on DLCI address.

methods.name: modem_cmux_process_received_byte
methods.description: Processes a single byte from the received stream, managing state machine.

methods.name: modem_cmux_receive_handler
methods.description: Main receive loop, reads from pipe and processes bytes.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_notify_transmit_idle
methods.description: Notifies all DLCIs that the transmit buffer is idle.

methods.name: modem_cmux_transmit_handler
methods.description: Handles transmission of buffered frames.

methods.name: modem_cmux_connect_handler
methods.description: Handles connection establishment, sends SABM frame.

methods.name: modem_cmux_disconnect_handler
methods.description: Handles disconnection, sends DISC frame.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_pipe_api_open
methods.description: API to open DLCI pipe, schedules open work.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_pipe_api_transmit
methods.description: API to transmit data over DLCI pipe.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_pipe_api_receive
methods.description: API to receive data from DLCI pipe.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_pipe_api_close
methods.description: API to close DLCI pipe, schedules close work.

methods.name: modem_cmux_init
methods.description: Initializes the modem_cmux structure with configuration.

methods.name: modem_cmux_dlci_init
methods.description: Initializes a DLCI structure and attaches it to the cmux.

methods.name: modem_cmux_attach
methods.description: Attaches a modem pipe to the cmux.

methods.name: modem_cmux_connect
methods.description: Synchronously connects the cmux, waiting for event.

methods.name: modem_cmux_connect_async
methods.description: Starts asynchronous connection process.

methods.name: modem_cmux_disconnect
methods.description: Synchronously disconnects the cmux, waiting for event.

methods.name: modem_cmux_disconnect_async
methods.description: Starts asynchronous disconnection process.

methods.name: modem_cmux_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the cmux, cancels work, releases pipe.
